name: msg91-verification-and-listener-desktop-fix
changes: Correct MSG91 OTPs no longer fail when verifyAccessToken omits the phone identifier or returns the national-number form
When MSG91 does expose an identifier, the backend still rejects a genuine identifier mismatch
Customer and listener login screens now use one primary action with compact resend/forgot/change-number links
Listener login uses a wide two-column tablet/desktop layout while the <=700px mobile layout is left unchanged
Signed-in listener desktop/tablet navigation is moved to a stable top navigation row instead of a floating bottom bar
Listener desktop/tablet home hero and availability controls are resized for laptop and PC screens
Customer/listener registration and forgot-password continue to use MSG91 OTP; returning accounts use passwords
